facts.source_fact: The 2026 methodology note documents a fluoropolymer-production method change for UK GHG statistics.
Hydrofluorocarbon emissions from fluoropolymer production are estimated and included in UK GHG totals for the first time under the described change.
facts.expected_handling: Mark the source as newly included.

facts.source_fact: The fluoropolymer HFC estimates use Pollution Inventory data.
Additional site-level Environment Agency data are used alongside Pollution Inventory data.
facts.expected_handling: Keep site-level source provenance with estimates.

facts.source_fact: The fluoropolymer-production change is exclusive to the industry sector.
facts.expected_handling: Do not propagate the change to unrelated sectors.

facts.source_fact: The change leads to a small increase in HFC emissions estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Treat magnitude as a methodology impact rather than a facility measurement.

facts.source_fact: HFC-23 is one of the HFC species affected by the new fluoropolymer-production estimate.
HFC-32 is one of the HFC species affected by the new fluoropolymer-production estimate.
HFC-125 is one of the HFC species affected by the new fluoropolymer-production estimate.
Final 1990-2024 UK GHG statistics were published and updated in 2026 after the planning note.
facts.expected_handling: Use final-release versioning for production values.

guard_patterns.handling: Distinguish new inclusion from revision of an existing source.
Carry Pollution Inventory and EA site-data provenance.
Keep HFC-23, HFC-32 and HFC-125 distinct.
Treat the small increase as model impact, not direct measurement.
Cross-check final values against final release.
Do not infer parcel-level HFC emissions.
Flag source, gas or version conflicts.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; 10 x 10 = 100 controls
